messages:
Maria (sales): Quick heads-up — FinMate wants a POC with tenant-level geo-sticky egress. They want EU traffic to always exit in EU, APAC in SG, and BYOK using their Azure key vault. Also asked who our sub-processors are in APAC. Can we do this for a 30-day POC?
Anika (presales): We can support tenant pinning for routing during a POC. Need to confirm: is guaranteed egress locality a hard requirement or a preference? Also BYOK adds extra onboarding time (KMS trust and rotation).
Maria (sales): It's a hard requirement for data residency during the POC — legal flagged it. They want a short pricing note for egress delta + BYOK onboarding fee.
Lee (solutions): For POC mode we can enable a "tenant_pin" routing policy that prefers region-local pools. Important caveats: 1) we have failover to global pool if regional capacity exhausted (can be disabled but increases risk); 2) sticky routing increases capacity overhead (more reserved slots per tenant).
Lee (solutions): Sample policy snippet we use in POCs:
```json
{
  "routing": {
    "mode": "tenant_pin",
    "preferred_regions": ["eu-west-1", "asia-southeast-1"],
    "fallback": "global",
    "sticky_ttl": 86400
  }
}
```
Harper (cloudops): Sub-processor list for APAC: Microsoft Azure (Southeast Asia), GCP (asia-southeast1) for caching edge, and our infra partner (EdgeCompute Co.). Full certs/attestation link: https://redwood.example.com/subprocessors (internal). For BYOK: we support Azure Key Vault and customer-managed keys via KMS integration. Ops notes: we need tenant's subscription id + key rotation policy.
Harper (cloudops): Ops checklist for KMS BYOK POC:
- exchange public keys + principal
- create service principal for Redwood in their tenant
- test encrypt/decrypt + rotation window
- configure network egress rule to SG/EU pools
(Expect ~3 business days for onboarding)
Maria (sales): Good — timeline makes sense. Pricing? They asked for a split model: customer pays KMS charges, Redwood covers baseline. What do we give them as a ballpark?
Lee (solutions): Recommend this template for POC pricing: one-time BYOK integration fee: $2,500; regional pinning add-on: $1,200/month (covers reserved capacity overhead); egress delta billed at $0.09/GB (pass-through to cloud egress). KMS operations (rotations + audits): $300/month optional. These are ballpark — legal/sales can firm up.
Anika (presales): I'll draft the SOW with those numbers and mark items requiring legal attestation (subprocessor list & data flow diagram). @Harper can you attach ops runbook + confirm certs?
Harper (cloudops): Attaching runbook in follow-up thread. Also note: to remove fallback (i.e., strictly local), we need a signed risk acceptance from customer — otherwise we keep fallback enabled by default.
deploy-bot: Policy lint OK — `tenant_pin` config validated (ticket #POC-9876).
Maria (sales): Perfect. I'll send the draft SOW to the customer and loop in Legal for the attestation. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
